Trusty is a document question-answering application built with FastAPI and LangGraph.
It uses a hybrid retriever combining BM25 and Chroma vector search.
The primary LLM provider is Groq, with OpenRouter as a fallback.
Trusty supports PDF, TXT, CSV, XLSX, images, audio, ZIP archives, and URLs as input formats.
The system uses three agents: a relevance checker, a research agent, and a verification agent.
Each user session is isolated using a session ID passed in the X-Session-ID header.
Trusty's verification agent checks every answer against the source documents before returning it.
If an answer is not supported by the documents, Trusty retries up to a maximum of two attempts.
